scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n core,adapter-eventemitter,adapter-eventtarget,cloud,server,web,demo "npm run dev -w @eda-debugger/core" "npm run dev -w @eda-debugger/adapter-eventemitter" "npm run dev -w @eda-debugger/adapter-eventtarget" "npm run dev -w @eda-debugger/cloud" "npm run dev -w @eda-debugger/server" "npm run dev -w @eda-debugger/viewer" "npm run dev -w @eda-debugger/demo"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @eda-debugger/core && npm run build -w @eda-debugger/adapter-eventemitter -w @eda-debugger/adapter-eventtarget -w @eda-debugger/cloud
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @eda-debugger/server && npm run build -w @eda-debugger/viewer
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-eventemitter && tsc --noEmit -p packages/adapter-eventtarget && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cloud && tsc --noEmit -p apps/viewer && tsc --noEmit -p apps/demo && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server
